svg.title: Agentic healthcare integration architecture
svg.desc: One Agent generates and repairs candidate code. Independent tests check outputs. Human approval pins exact code. Query mode runs approved code without an Agent.

g.text: EXL x Trinity 2026 / Challenge 01 / Proposed prototype architecture
Human confirms the plan and unclear meanings. The controller enforces repair and runtime limits.
Approval binds exact code, task/source contracts, test baseline and a passing report. Changes require re-testing and re-approval.
Synthetic data only. Input-only batches are previews. Query mode does not generate or repair code.
